description: Start a done-for-you campaign. Send kind (boost, content or topvoice), name, account_id (one of the organization's connected LinkedIn accounts) and settings. A boost campaign takes keywords, people or companies to watch and any of react, comment, follow and invite, with per_day up to 40; a topvoice campaign takes a topic whose watched voices it answers (or voices to name them outright), top, within_hours and the same four actions; a content campaign takes a brief, an optional voice and topics, posts_per_week up to 14, hours, timezone, approve (manual or auto, manual by default) and as_company. Add key_id to name which of the organization's own AI keys writes the words, room_id to have it report into a project room, and state: running to have it begin at once. -- MakeHybrid API plan, POST /linkedin/campaigns, group campaigns.

query.description: Optional query-string parameters, e.g. {"limit":"20","cursor":"..."}. Values are coerced to strings.
